[[Morbach]] crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the [[Kurzick armor]] art. Morbach also crafts [[Elementalist headgear#Auras|Elementalist auras]].
All armor is crafted with an empty [[insignia slot]].

Kurzick armor requires the rare crafting material [[Amber Chunk]].
